title: Kernel artifact location
responsibility: Finds an existing kernel build record and available Wasm/native files without building or running them.

inputs.name: kernelArtifacts.env
inputs.description: Environment map, defaulting to process.env. HARNESS_KERNEL_DIR restricts lookup to its resolved directory; otherwise known bundle/checkout locations are tried.

outputs.name: kernelArtifacts
outputs.description: Build directory, parsed build record and paths of existing Wasm/native artifacts, or all undefined when no build.json is found.
